dedupe_keys.name: tum battery electric vehicle and truck charging behaviour surveys

description: The Charging Behavior Survey contains 348 responses from battery-electric passenger-vehicle users and professional truck drivers. The Technical University of Munich team collected responses from December 2022 to February 2023 through charging-station QR codes and an existing professional-driver contact pool. The repository supplies German originals and English translations, question encodings, response translations, JSON type definitions and Python import examples. Zenodo states GPL-3.0-or-later licensing and free public access. The sample covers Germany, with passenger recruitment around Munich, and combines actual behaviour with anticipated charging choices. Recruitment through selected charging stations and known drivers limits population representativeness; intentions are not observed future charging sessions. A reviewer-assessed use is parameterizing charging-location choices and demand schedules in transport-energy simulations. model-sumo is a related transport simulator, but response categories were not translated into executable agents. No response file was downloaded and no personal-level analysis was performed.
